lines: Best placement of the ≥ 1″ area: GEFS P75 (ETS 0.52).
Closest on the peak: REFS LPMM, 3.42″ vs 5.88″ observed at its resolution (58%).
Far too dry overall (under half the observed rain volume): ECMWF IFS 21%, ECMWF ENS mean 22%, ECMWF AIFS 22%, ECMWF ENS P75 27%.
Earliest signal: GFS reached half the observed peak 72 h before the window started.
summary.method: Score = mean of placement (ETS at the event threshold ÷ 0.5, capped at 1), peak (e^-|ln ratio| of forecast to observed near-max at the model's resolution) and volume (e^-|ln bias|), each from the model's shortest-lead run.
